protocol: Frozen test split: four people (S3/S5/S7/S8) never used in development, tuning or earlier held-out scoring. Score each frozen candidate once; do not tune on these results.
selection: One centred 30 s window per sequence, start=(video_frames-span)//2 with span=(750-1)*stride+1, fixed before any inference. S3/S5 are 50 Hz and decimated by stride 2 to the 25 Hz clock; S7/S8 are 25 Hz.
reference: annot3 markerless multiview reference, body12; inference reads only RGB, calibration and timing.
